summary: Gravel picnic clearing off the road, ringed by bush, no homes nearby.
reasons: Off-lane gravel clearing in dense bush

drivers.seclusion: Dense eucalypt bush on all sides; nearest mapped home is about 36 m from the start of the line, far from this section.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel apron meets the road edge; room for a van clear of the lane, tyre-compacted ground visible.
drivers.traffic: Quiet bush road, power lines overhead; a few cars parked off the road nearby.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the pull-offs here; the picnic tables suggest day use, no signs mapped.

flags: Slightly steep: about 3.6% grade, up to 5% either side
Day-use picnic area, may see visitors in daytime
Mapped gate near the start of the line, a route runs around it
sun_shade: Heavy canopy shade, mostly from the east and south; open gravel patch gets midday sun from the north.
cannot_judge: Whether the picnic area is closed at night

best_section.where: Gravel picnic area with tables, just south of the bend at the 500 m mark
